This is going to be the official course page for CS410 in Spring 2027.

## Timetable

Teaching runs from 18 January to 4 April 2027 (11 weeks).

| What | When | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Lecture | Monday 10:00–11:00 | [GH732](https://www.strath.ac.uk/maps/?building=grahamhillsbuilding) |
| Lecture | Tuesday 14:00–15:00 | [TG227](https://www.strath.ac.uk/maps/?building=thomasgrahambuilding) |
| Lab and tutorial | Monday 11:00–12:00 | [LT1201](https://www.strath.ac.uk/maps/?building=livingstonetower) |
